Twelve comments

Little Bird

A very beautiful tune written by Tim Edey in 2005 for Sharon Shannon as a birthday present,
and it’s absolutely NOT a hornpipe, I will call it an air. I Heard it with Kilfenora Céili Band.
I think it’s composed in F, but it’s much more easy in D with a capo on - (banjo)
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=V3QD7nAaFUE#t=14

Here’s the F version:
